svg.title: The curve is the model; the threshold is a business decision
svg.desc: A logistic S-curve drawn through eighteen pass and fail study-hour points, with a red dashed vertical threshold at 2.710 hours carrying a slider handle and a double-headed arrow, beside two insets contrasting the clean log-loss bowl with a crossed-out flat-shelved squared-error curve at curvature -0.120, and two arrows of wildly different length showing a 203-times gradient difference on the same wrong point.
svg.text: The curve is the model; the threshold is a business decision
you move this. Cost decides where.
a flat loss on a confidently
wrong answer is a model that
same shape as M2 - only y-hat changed
...and if only 1 row in 1000 is positive? -> W20
